changes.title: Official backups restore fully; last polish items; records for the five waves
changes.detail:
Backups - Member names with a leading "./" (older Supervisor archives) are found, so such a backup is no longer refused as a wrong password; an archive with no core backup gets its own error. - A backup from a newer release is refused before anything is scheduled, with the version named; the startup check stays as the last defence. - Versions are compared by year and month against the three-part core version, so a later patch of the same month is accepted and this product's fourth part no longer gets in the way. New backups carry the three-part version, so official builds accept them. - A backup name with a path separator is tidied on read instead of the upload being refused. The first-run restore page shows each line once and says why a restore was refused. - Server tests: 509 pass in the backup folder (478 before) with the same 10 failures on both trees, which come from the test harness; 50 pass in the restore test file. Ten real backup files were read and checked.

Interface polish - The selected page tab scrolls clear of the edge fade; Select is clear of the Add device button; Blueprints descriptions wrap on a phone and the Use button is 44 px there; the automation history tabl
changes.detail_yue: 官方版備份而家還原得晒：舊式檔名頭嗰個「./」唔再當係密碼錯；新過自己嘅 備份喺郁手之前就拒絕，唔會熄咗機先至話唔得；版本淨係睇年同月，同一個月 嘅補丁版照收，我哋自己整嘅備份官方版都食得落。仲有最後四樣執靚功夫， 同埋五波工程嘅紀錄一次過寫返好。

changes.title: Wave 5 of five: header page tools, setup flows, support tickets, command search keys
changes.detail:
- Dashboard header carries the page tools cluster (view, edit, locked, phone, embedded). - First-run integrations step: cards plus a failure-safe state machine. - Guided setup: 14-day draft, jump rules, Save and close, side step list. - Nest registration guidance in Google setup (six-step checklist, project ID check). - Support page Tickets section: create, list, status, search, notes, close and reopen. - Command search: wrapping arrows, Space toggle, Escape, status line, three new entries. - Cantonese source now covers the new onboarding, Google setup and guided setup keys.

Checks: type check shows only the two allowed gallery errors; full suite has only the allowed build-management failures after the Cantonese coverage fix; wording scan clean. Nothing here has been seen in a running build.
changes.detail_yue: 呢一浪係第五浪，亦係最後一浪：儀表板頂部加咗頁面工具列，首次設定嘅整合步驟變咗 唔易死機嘅狀態機，引導設定可以儲存草稿同跳步，Google 設定有 Nest 登記清單， 支援頁有工單，指令搜尋夠晒鍵盤操作。型別檢查只剩兩個預期錯誤，掃描乾淨。 但係冇一樣喺真正運行嘅版本入面睇過，個代碼自己話冇事，我哋都要打個問號。

changes.title: Wave 4 of five: type scale, type fields, named palette, practise control, tab group search, General page help
changes.detail: Six items, all built and unit-tested, none yet seen in a running build. - Type scale: ratio, base and per-step sizes in the fonts dialog, off by default, multiplied with Text size, applied at startup; all nine theme sizes written monotonically. Sync and Cantonese strings for it are not done. - Appearance editor for type: typeface, weight, italic, line height, letter spacing, capitals, alignment and maximum lines, each with a reset and a small-text warning. - Named palette in both colour tools: 48 named colours, nearest name, gamut chips and a keyboard-operable rainbow strip. - Setting information panel: optional worked example and a practise control that saves and sends nothing. - New tab catalog: a separate search per group, with Close matching on Pinned and Pages. - General settings page: an information button on each of the eight settings and a confirmed Reset on seven. - The Cantonese source now covers the colour palette and General help blocks (fixes a language-mode test). Checks: type check shows only the two allowed gallery errors; full suite 6145 passed, 4 failed (3 allowed build-management tests plus the language-mode coverage test, fixed afterwards and now passing); chang
changes.detail_yue: 呢一浪一口氣收埋六樣嘢：字階、字體欄位、命名調色盤、練習掣、分組搜尋同一般設定說明。全部寫好又有單元測試，不過未喺跑緊嘅版本度見過。有個粵語區塊覆蓋測試一開始紅咗燈，原來係代碼忘記登記新區塊，補返之後就綠晒，真係個清單自己漏咗自己。

changes.title: Wave 3 of five: test cases, dry run, repository strip, save bar, starting points
changes.detail: Items in this wave, none seen in a running browser: - Named test cases and a simulated run in the history manager: named cases per automation kept in the browser, and a run that decides conditions against fake states only and calls no service. - Dry run of a whole automation and a bottom bar with Run now, Check, Dry run and Save. The visual and blueprint editors still draw their own bar, so two bars show there. - Repository strip in the automation editor and a Push action on the repository page (host shown only). - One save bar behaviour in the script and scene editors: hide when clean, Discard, live announcements. - Tests that a backup carries every automation repository; written, not run (no securetar on this machine). - Starting points for an empty automation and an empty script, six each. Also in this commit: other small changes from the same wave (tables, tabs, personal settings, updates, home tiles, users page).
changes.detail_yue: 呢一浪嘅嘢：歷史管理加咗命名測試個案同模擬運行，只對住假狀態，唔會叫任何服務；自動化加咗整份乾跑同底部掣條；編輯器出咗倉庫條；腳本同場景嘅儲存條識得收埋、放棄同報讀結果；空白自動化同腳本有開頭範本；仲有備份測試寫好咗但未跑得（呢部機冇 securetar）。全部都未喺瀏覽器睇過，個 code 都算乖，淨係有兩條舊 gallery 嘅 build 錯誤同三個老友測試喺度扮喊。

changes.title: Wave 2 of five: stacked toasts, notification severity, statistics strip, draft recovery, update rows, element menu entries
changes.detail:
- Stacked toasts: up to three visible, queue with a "more waiting" chip, per-toast timers that pause on hover or focus, duplicate suppression, one polite live region, reduced-motion fade. - Notification severity: level taken only from an explicit id marker; edge, icon and word on each row, filter chips, sort by severity then newest. - Collapsible statistics strip on the shared list layout (optional property, remembered per page). - Draft recovery for the template editor: debounced save, secret and size refusal, banner with Restore, Compare and Discard. - Update installs shown as rows in the activity tray, with recovery card and Show update. - Context menu entries resolved from the clicked entity, device, area or link. - The Cantonese source now covers the new toast, statistics and draft blocks in the language list. - Records: changelog, roadmap, feature status and the interface docs index updated.

Checks: type check shows only the two known gallery import-pages errors; full test run has only the three known build-management failures after the language-list fix. Nothing has been seen in a running build yet.
changes.detail_yue: 呢一浪（五浪之第二）加咗疊埋嘅 toast、通知嘅嚴重程度顏色、可以摺埋嘅統計條、範本編輯器 嘅草稿復原、更新安裝喺活動托盤入面嘅列，仲有按住元素彈出嘅選單新項目。程式碼之前唔肯 認廣東話區塊，而家教識佢，測試先肯行過。型別檢查淨係剩返兩個已知嘅 gallery 錯誤，全套 測試淨係剩返三個已知嘅 build-management 失敗。仲未喺真正運行嘅版本入面睇過，所以紀錄 入面全部寫明「未見過」，唔好當佢食咗糊。

changes.title: Wave 1 of five: selection bar and bulk actions on six more tables
changes.detail: - Tags: bulk delete with a preview, a warning for tags an automation tag trigger still uses, per-tag failure reporting. 11 unit tests. - Dashboards: show in sidebar, hide from sidebar and delete; the default dashboard, built-in pages and YAML dashboards are skipped with a reason. - Resources: bulk delete with a preview of each address; the page cannot tell which dashboards use a resource, and the preview says so. - Scenes: move to category, add and remove label, move to area, apply and delete with previews; apply runs scenes in order, YAML scenes are skipped on delete. - Blueprints: re-import from the saved address and delete; blueprints still in use are not deleted, and usage is re-read before deleting. - Backups: bulk delete with name, date, size, newest-backup and only-copy lines; locked and unfinished backups are skipped. - Shared bar: the preview list is height-limited and scrolls. - Checks: lint:types shows only the two gallery build/import-pages errors; full test run 5898 passed, 5 failed (3 in build-management as allowed, 2 in language-mode caused by a Cantonese block outside the covered prefixes, fixed by removing that block from yue-own.json). Public wording scan clean. N
changes.detail_yue: 呢一浪（五浪之第一浪）將選取列同批量操作加到標籤、儀表板、資源、場景、藍圖同備份六個表。 刪除之前一律先預覽、要㩒兩下確認，逐項處理，失敗嘅會留低並列名。粵語字串擺錯咗位， 測試即刻嗌救命，搬走就乖返；程式碼認錯好快，真係好有禮貌。仲未喺運行緊嘅版本睇過。

changes.title: Touch targets: sliders, compact fields and table filter chips are 44 px on a touch screen
changes.detail: Found by looking at build 119 on a phone-sized touch screen: a slider reacted only in its middle 32 px, the compact outlined text field was 32 px high, and the filter chips beside a table's search field were 32 px high. The colour field's marker covered the Hue label when the colour was black. Records: the batch 27 fixes that were seen in build 119.
changes.detail_yue: 用手指撳嘅地方要夠大：滑桿之前淨係中間 32 像素有反應，撳邊邊當你透明；細格 文字欄同表格隔籬嗰排篩選掣都係 32 像素。而家全部 44 像素。揀色嗰粒圓點亦 唔再遮住「色相」兩個字。

changes.title: Batch 27: settings saved on the instance, locks on plain http, schedule entity rules, release only when green
changes.detail:
Interface - Every personal setting is saved on the instance for the account and follows it to every device (preferences, schedules, locks, table layouts, saved patterns, history, name and logo, tool drafts). Tokens, caches, per-device switches and typed console text stay in the browser. A review proved an upload loop and an upload after an account switch in another tab; both are fixed with tests. - Locks: creating one works on a page without crypto.subtle (plain http) through a script fallback that gives the browser's answers; names come from the card's label or heading; stored waits and rounds are bounded; the start cover is re-checked after the instance copy arrives. - Schedule rules can depend on an entity (is, is not, above, below). - Plain browser selects, sliders, checkboxes, radios and colour inputs are replaced with the product's own controls in 20 files; a test fails on a new one. - Seven messages that could not be formatted are fixed and a test parses every string; info button names; notification selection; YAML tools title; a plural; touch targets; Personal settings no longer pans sideways on a phone.

Build and release - A release is created only by a final job when eve
changes.detail_yue: 第 27 批：設定唔再淨係擺喺瀏覽器，跟住戶口去晒每部機；把鎖喺普通 http 都 整得成；時間表可以睇住實體嘅狀態；啲求其嘅原生下拉選單、滑桿、剔格仔全部 換晒自家貨。發佈流程亦都改咗規矩：成條流水線全綠先至出版本，紅咗或者 俾人截咗就乜都唔出，唔會再有空殼版本。作業系統映像今日食咗三次檸檬，全因 出面一個模組站唔應機，而家先問官方鏡像。

changes.title: Personal settings: the page can no longer be dragged sideways on a phone
changes.detail: The row of group chips took the width of all its chips (666 px in a 358 px page), which made the page wider than the screen. The narrow layout now stretches its children to the page width and the chip row scrolls inside itself. Measured in a running copy at 390 px with the rule applied: the row is 358 px.
changes.detail_yue: 個人設定喺手機度可以成版打橫拖走，原來係嗰排分類掣闊到 666 像素，撐爆咗 358 像素嘅版面。而家排掣乖乖喺自己度碌，個版唔再周圍走。
